definitions.explanation: A person who officiates at a sporting event, making decisions on rules and play.
An official decision or verdict, especially in a legal or religious context.

examples.japanese: {審判|しんぱん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ファウル→ファウル：06584_fauru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{審判|しんぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They protested against the referee's decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{審判|しんぱん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公平|こうへい}→公平：01648_kouhei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧。
examples.english: That referee is fair and highly trusted by the players.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{審判|しんぱん}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a religious concept called the Last Judgment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{審判|しんぱん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}された→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: A judgment was handed down by the court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{審判|しんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられる→耐える：12087_taeru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧。
examples.english: Whether it can withstand the judgment of history, time will tell.

notes:
{審判|しんぱん} can refer to both the person (referee/umpire) and the act of judging.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {審判|しんぱん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as referee)
- {審判|しんぱん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧ (referee's decision)
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{審判|しんぱん} (the Last Judgment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {審判|しんぱん}: general term for sports officials; also used for divine/legal judgment
- ⟦レフェリー→レフェリー：noentry⟧: referee (borrowed from English, mainly for boxing, soccer)
- ⟦アンパイア→アンパイア：noentry⟧: umpire (borrowed, mainly for baseball)
